subject: Stack shift: Demo parked — follow-up and next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Cooper <evan.cooper@novanet.com>, Priya Das <priya.das@novanet.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro demo: Redwood inference for Novanet — proposed times

Hi Evan / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Per our conversation about model-serving costs and latency requirements, I put together a short live demo that shows:
- Typical latency and throughput for a 4k-token sequence on our Dedicated tier
- How Smart Routing falls back to cheaper variants without failing requests
- Prefix caching and a quick look at cost impact for bursty traffic

Proposed times (PST):
• Tue Nov 9 — 10:00–10:30
• Wed Nov 10 — 14:00–14:30
• Thu Nov 11 — 09:00–09:30

If none work, tell me windows that do and we’ll adapt. Demo will be ~25 minutes with 10 minutes for Q&A. I can share the short checklist/asks sheet in the calendar invite (data access, NAT rules, sample prompt set).

Attachments: redwood-demo-checklist.pdf (stub)

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Direct: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Evan Cooper <evan.cooper@novanet.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Das <priya.das@novanet.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo: Redwood inference for Novanet — proposed times

Hi Karthik,

Appreciate you setting this up. Quick update from our side — leadership pushed a Q4 reorg last Friday. We’re migrating our delivery stack to a new orchestration layer and shifting resources to that migration for the next two quarters. Given that, the inference/LLM work has been deprioritized and we need to park any external demos for now.

Specifics:
- Platform migration sprint consumes our infra and platform engineering teams through end of Q1.
- Two key engineers who would be on the demo are traveling Nov 8–Nov 20 for customer workshops.
- Our roadmap doc (attached) reflects the shift.

Can we do the following?
1) Park the demo for the next 90 days and keep the thread active.
2) If something changes sooner, we’ll ping you.
3) Please share any one-pagers or recorded walkthroughs in the meantime so we can keep folks informed asynchronously.

Sorry to stall — frustrating timing on our end.

Best,
Evan Cooper
Dir. Product Ops, Novanet
Attachment: Novanet_Q4_roadmap.pdf (stub)

Folks — forwarding Evan’s note. Novanet is pushing the inference work down the backlog due to a platform migration and some travel windows. Key asks / suggested next steps:

1) Move deal stage to: "Parked — customer reprioritized" in HubSpot.
2) Add a 90-day follow-up task; flag for sales cadence at 60 days to check for runway change.
3) Share a recorded demo + one-pager and an ultra-lightplay POC offer (two-week trial credit + dedicated office hours) so they have something tangible to review while they migrate.
4) Keep the contact list: Evan (product ops), Priya (infra) — they might re-open earlier.

I’ll prepare the recorded walkthrough and a one-pager; Monica can you draft the offer terms (trial credits / office hours)? Laura — can you update HubSpot and add the follow-up tasks?

Attachments: redwood-internal-playbook.md (stub)

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Intro demo: Redwood inference for Novanet — proposed times

Thanks Karthik — I’ll take the lead on the offer. Plan:

- Draft a 2-week trial credit: $2k worth of Dedicated credits + two 1-hr office hours with a solutions engineer.
- Create a short recorded demo (15m) with a timestamped checklist so Evan/Priya can share internally.
- Laura, I’ll need HubSpot updated to stage: PARKED_PROSPECT; set reminder for 60/90/180 days and add the Novanet roadmap doc link.

We should also add a low-touch nurture sequence (monthly product update + case study relevant to migrations) — I’ll draft the first email. If they unblock earlier, we keep the calendar slots flexible.

Status: marking as parked in CRM and adding tasks. I’ll share the drafted offer and the recorded demo by EOD Friday.

Monica
